segment.source: Renders a single photograph across the full width of the viewport with the headline, lead and actions set on a scrim over it. Use it for: brand and campaign home pages, hotel, venue and travel sites, editorial covers, association and cultural pages, anywhere the picture is the argument. Prefer 'Split Media Hero' when the image must stay uncropped beside the text, and 'Video Hero' when the same picture would work better as a film.
